verdict.rationale: The README states that smolagents supports any LLM: local transformers or ollama models, Hub providers, and OpenAI, Anthropic and others via LiteLLM. The docs show the model passed as a single constructor argument (`CodeAgent(tools=[], model=model)`), so swapping providers comes down to changing that one object rather than rewriting the agent. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the model classes and how to switch between them, evidence that agent behaviour stays consistent across providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of provider swapping.
